body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Models neutron transport and reactor physics within validated frameworks. Reactor neutronics software solves the Boltzmann transport equation with deterministic (Sn) or Monte Carlo methods for criticality, flux, and depletion. Real implementations include SCALE, OpenMC, Serpent, and MCNP. It is used within licensed, validated frameworks for design and safety analysis. Engineering analysis use only.

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Nuclear Reactor Neutronics Analysis Software, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Criticality (keff) with uncertainty). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Criticality (keff) with uncertainty and Depletion and fuel-cycle analysis. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Plasma physics simulation framework) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
